caseName: Charter Commc'ns, Inc. v. Nat'l Ass'n of African Am.-Owned Media
caseNameFull: CHARTER COMMUNICATIONS, INC. v. NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF AFRICAN AMERICAN-OWNED MEDIA

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for further consideration in light of Comcast Corp. v. National Assn. of African American-Owned Media , 589 U.S. ---- (2020). The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
